# Governance Checklist: Freeze the property-intelligence data contract

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of A-02's spec, plan and test cases against the constitution (Parts 1–3 and the Task A addendum), the ARD, the story ACs and `testplans/A-02-test-cases.md`. Not a UI story.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [test cases](../../../testplans/A-02-test-cases.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Constitution Part 1: Engineering (I–XII)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the "no hosted runtime until A-03" exception to Art. I stated with where the hosted proof happens later (A-13, A-15)? [Consistency, Plan § Constitution Check I, Spec § Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "real Travis County data only" stated for every input (Austin `3syk-w9eu`, TCAD 2026 certified export, Census 2024 Gazetteer), with no fixture data allowed in the contract or sample? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, ARD P0-12]
- [ ] CHK003 Do the requirements say that all new code is TypeScript, and that only the kit's own tools (elephant-cli, the vendored estimator) may be non-TS? [Completeness, Plan § Technical Context, Art. II]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the deferral of Turborepo (Art. IV) justified with a named later owner and story? [Consistency, Plan § Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK005 Is Zod validation required for every external input the story reads: Socrata rows, TCAD records, Census rows, the lexicon manifest, profile and gazetteer files? [Coverage, Art. V, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are bounded-concurrency, backoff and stop-on-403 limits quantified for every source fetch (Austin, Census, lexicon manifest)? [Clarity, Art. VII, Spec § Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the absence of Lambdas (so no Powertools, DLQ or alarm in A-02) stated rather than silently skipped? [Completeness, Plan § Constitution Check VII–IX]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the CI gap (Art. X) recorded as an exception, with the local substitute named (Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, tsc)? [Consistency, Plan § Constitution Check X]
- [ ] CHK009 Is data honesty (Art. XI) specified per field: does every view column have a defined missing reason, and is the reason enum a closed list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, data-model § Provenance]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it stated that no secrets are needed and that captures, CARs and Parquet stay out of git except the D-07 sample? [Clarity, Art. XII, ARD P0-17, D-07]

## Constitution Part 2: Kit-agent ownership (XIII–XVII)

- [ ] CHK011 Do the story front matter, spec header and plan Kit Agent Ownership name the same design, builder, reviewer and verify agents as AGENT-MAP row A-02? [Consistency, Art. XIII]
- [ ] CHK012 Does `agent-design.md` hold one verbatim answer per design agent (mew, oracle), and does the plan cite it section by section? [Traceability, Art. XIV]
- [ ] CHK013 Is every builder pattern listed in the plan mapped to a concrete file path? [Completeness, Art. XV, Plan § Patterns]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the reviewer agents, the 0–100 score, the ≥ 75 threshold and the record location (`docs/reviews/CR-A-02.md`) specified? [Completeness, Art. XVI]
- [ ] CHK015 Are mew/oracle disagreements each resolved with a named PO decision and owner rule (mew on names, oracle on pipeline mechanics)? [Consistency, agent-design § Disagreements, run-log D-4]

## Constitution Part 3: Delivery (XVIII–XXIII)

- [ ] CHK016 Is every gate (G4, G5, G6) recorded with a report path, verdict history and PO decision before implementation? [Traceability, Art. XVIII, docs/traceability.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Do all artifacts carry `id` and `parent` front matter, and do the commit-message rules require the `A-02:` prefix? [Completeness, Art. XIX]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the branch rule (`002-data-contract`, merged `--no-ff` after G7, never `main`) stated? [Clarity, Art. XX]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec contain no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`, and are all ACs in Given / When / Then form? [Completeness, Art. XXI]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the test cases derived from the ACs, not from tasks.md, with the hosted-URL rule replaced by a stated exception? [Consistency, Art. XXII, G6 C-05/C-09]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the defect-record rule (`docs/defects/ERR-{n}.md`, starting at ERR-9) referenced for failing cases? [Gap, Art. XXIII]

## Task A addendum (A1–A8)

- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified that the transforms follow the kit skills (`build-county-transform`, `county-seed-data`, `county-permit-adapter`) and that the estimator is vendored unmodified? [Completeness, A1, Plan § Kit Agent Ownership]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the order validate → hash → validate CAR → export-tables fixed in the requirements, with "no upload" and "no step skipped" stated? [Clarity, A2, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the ban on any Query DB read or export in A-02 stated explicitly? [Gap, A2, ARD § 7]
- [ ] CHK025 Is CIDv1 required for every identifier, including the local pilot manifest, with the computation method named? [Clarity, A3, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the pilot manifest required to list CARs, the tables directory with `carCid`, and part CIDs with size and SHA-256? [Completeness, A4, contracts/manifest.md]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it stated that no contractor identity is asserted in A-02 and that BBB is "not checked" with a reason? [Consistency, A5, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Is stop-on-403 with no retry, identity change or bypass stated for Austin and Census? [Clarity, A6, Spec § Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it stated that A-02 creates no cloud resources? [Completeness, A7, Plan § Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Are only kit-bundled skills referenced, never the deprecated `../skills` copy? [Consistency, A8]

## Acceptance criteria quality (AC-1 to AC-8)

- [ ] CHK031 Are the nine AC-1 fields listed identically in the story, spec FR-001, data model and test case TC-001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK032 Is "a pilot row where it appears" defined precisely (table + `cid` + non-null value)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the "drafted, not filed" status of extension requests consistent across the story, spec, ADR plan and TC-003? [Consistency, D-1]
- [ ] CHK034 Is "exactly the AD-07 names" bound to a single authoritative column list that the README, schemas and tests all derive from? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, contracts/views.md]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the D-4a rule "empty published status means stalled" stated with its guard (excluded and needs_review never emitted) in the spec, data model and README requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, data-model § Views]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the AC-3 sample population, seed rule and judge defined so that two reviewers would draw the same 25 permits? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, research R-10]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the AC-5 equality (include − excludes − trade − needs_review) defined with "same run" timing, so daily dataset drift can't break it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the AC-6 expected values (GEOID, point, source URL, file date, SHA-256) fully specified for at least one place, and is `out_of_scope` defined as carrying no point? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK039 Does AC-7 name a missing reason for every derived column (tenure, roof age, open days, BBB, contractor, coordinates, owner area)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, data-model § Derivation rules]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the AC-8 row shape (one roofing permit plus its property columns) and the selection rule for the 20 rows stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Scenario and edge-case coverage (test cases)

- [ ] CHK041 Does every AC and FR have at least one test case, including the five required negatives (ZIP 99999, Auxiliary Power, unknown status, no-carrier reason, Expired never relabelled)? [Coverage, test cases § 2]
- [ ] CHK042 Are the recovery requirements defined for a pilot `validate` failure (fix the transform, never skip), and for a mid-run 403 (stop, blocked receipt)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec § Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK043 Are the unmatched-parcel requirements (null `tcad_id`, zero or multiple `geoID` matches) stated with reasons and counts? [Edge Case, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK044 Are the straddling-place and ZCTA ≠ ZIP cases defined with their exact outcomes (`partial_in_travis`, `zip_not_zcta`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, research R-08]
- [ ] CHK045 Are the NFR thresholds (≥ 24/25, ≤ 1 needs_review, 0 solar/PV/RTU; ≥ 80% coverage per package) measurable as written? [Measurability, Spec NFR-001, NFR-002]

- [ ] CHK046 Is the dependency on the live lexicon manifest and the CLI schema cache (MCP tools down) documented with a fallback that never uses memory? [Assumption, research R-01]
- [ ] CHK047 Is the elephant-cli pin (commit 44bb182, never Homebrew) stated wherever a CLI command appears? [Consistency, Plan § Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK048 Are the risks carried to later stories (ipfs.io/dweb.link 429 for Verify; kit transform-scripts PR) recorded with a target story? [Traceability, research R-12]
